abstract: Install, serve, tune, scale and troubleshoot NVIDIA Triton Inference Server. Covers NGC container flavors, model repository layout and config.pbtxt, model-control modes, dynamic batching, instance groups, ensembles, the vLLM and TensorRT-LLM backends, the OpenAI frontend, KServe v2 HTTP/gRPC, perf_analyzer, Prometheus metrics, Kubernetes, upgrades and error fixes. Includes config, compose and Kubernetes templates. Verified against Triton v2.73.0 (NGC 26.09).
